body:
Three oracle tests are RED on `origin/main` (d990e18c) and no battery sees them, because all three carry `@pytest.mark.slow_physics` and every routine command deselects that marker (`-m "not gpu and not slow and not slow_physics"`).

## Reproduced on main

```
PYTHONPATH=<main checkout> python -m pytest tests/oracle/test_leontovich_alpha_oracle.py -q -o addopts= -p no:cacheprovider \
  -k "alpha_envelope_regression_lock or o3_model_fits"
=> 2 failed, 11 deselected in 4.30s
```

| test | pinned | measured |
|---|---|---|
| `test_alpha_envelope_regression_lock` (two-plane comparator) | 0.72494 | **0.8733294904232025** (+20.5 %) |
| `test_o3_model_fits_measured_field` | RMS <= 0.01 | **0.0107697800** |
| `test_alpha_oracle_o3` | — | fails in the same battery |

The `test_alpha_envelope_regression_lock` docstring calls itself a DIAGNOSTIC pin whose purpose is that "any regression OR improvement of the node-thin sheet realization surfaces instead of drifting silently". It is drifting silently: a full CPU battery at the repo's usual marker set is green (measured 6140 passed / 0 failed / 37 skipped / 24 xfailed on a branch off d990e18c), and this red never appears in it.

## Why it matters beyond the three tests

The pins live in the `two_plane` / node-thin-sheet family (#702, #706/#707, #711, #720, #930) — exactly the realization family #931 is about. A 20 % move in the two-plane comparator is the size of signal that family's decisions are being made on.

## Two questions this raises

1. Which change moved the two-plane alpha, and is the new value right or wrong? The pin's own provenance line is "2026-08-19 #677 re-measure, fit ln-RMS resid 0.00245, settle -71.0 dB, two-plane alpha 0.72494".
2. Where, if anywhere, does `slow_physics` run? If the answer is "nowhere", the marker is a place tests go to stop being checked, and the honest fix is a scheduled lane that runs it and reports, not a wider tolerance.

Found while establishing a before-patch baseline for an unrelated experiment; the failures are present with zero local changes.

comments.body:
2026-09-11 상태 확인, `main` = `a2e3d558` (#931 머지 이후). 이 pod에서 재현:

```
PYTHONPATH=<main> python -m pytest tests/oracle/test_leontovich_alpha_oracle.py -q -o addopts= -p no:cacheprovider \
  -k "alpha_envelope_regression_lock or o3_model_fits or alpha_oracle_o3"
=> 2 failed, 1 passed
```

- `test_alpha_envelope_regression_lock`: 이제 통과. #931 phase 2 T6에서 프로파일과 함께 다시 측정해 핀을 고쳤다(`8cb1060d`). 이 이슈의 표에 있던 0.72494 → 0.8733 항목은 닫혔다.
- `test_o3_model_fits_measured_field`, `test_alpha_oracle_o3`: 여전히 빨강. 8 GHz rel RMS 0.0108 > 0.01. 이것은 #931이 알고 남긴 상태다. `b44b001b`가 O3 census(VESSL 369367259292)를 돌려 "8 GHz 한 칸이 아슬아슬하다"는 읽기를 기각했고, 다섯 칸 전부가 신뢰 게이트의 1.9~4.3배다. 모델은 안 움직였고(≤0.1 %), Ez와 Hy 두 추출 경로가 8 GHz에서 13 % 갈라졌다. 그 커밋이 다음 확인으로 지목한 것은 "두 fitted profile을 8 GHz에서 pre-#931 기록과 나란히 덤프해 어느 경로의 모양이 바뀌었는지 말하기"이고, 아직 안 했다.

이 이슈에 남는 질문은 두 번째 것이다. `slow_physics`가 어디서도 안 돈다면 빨강이 계속 조용히 남는다. 위 두 테스트는 마커를 지우는 게 아니라 (a) 프로파일 덤프로 경로 분기를 귀속하고 (b) `slow_physics`를 도는 예약 레인(#915 validation.yml 정리와 같은 자리)에 넣는 쪽으로 닫아야 한다.

title: Three slow_physics oracle tests are red on main and no battery sees them (leontovich alpha / two-plane comparator +20.5%)
